AGNES_EXECUTE.title: Execution
AGNES_EXECUTE.description: Agnes harvests every Echo Shard on the field and vents all of her Resonance at you for [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage.
ARKRUS_RESCUE.title: Rescue Hymn
ARKRUS_RESCUE.description: Arkrus chants a Rescue Hymn: [gold]heals[/gold] the dying Seraphion for [blue]50%[/blue] of its max HP and pulls it out of half-death.
